body.message:
Bed and bath linen for your hotel or hospitality business just got a whole lot closer!

​We are thrilled to announce the opening of our brand-new showroom, located just 5 minutes away from the Abu Baker Al Siddique Metro Station in Deira.

​Drop by to explore our extensive collection of 100% cotton bed and bath linen, crafted specifically for the hospitality industry at factory-direct, highly competitive prices.

​Whether you are upgrading guest rooms or stocking up for a new property, visit us at any of our convenient locations:

​New Showroom: Near Abu Baker Metro Station, Deira, Dubai (Just 5 mins away!)

​Existing Showroom: Murshid Bazar, Deira, Dubai

​Manufacturing Unit: Al Sanayya, Ajman

​Get in touch with us today to upgrade your guest experience with premium quality at unbeatable prices!
